integrity: Standalone analytic proof and reproducible exact rational and numerical checks; independent validation has not occurred. Possible implicit coverage in general nonlinear dissipativity literature remains.
limitations: No two-input variation Lipschitz assertion; no general graphs, multiple-branching trees, or independent audit. Infinitesimal growth rate uses nonlinear flux normalization, not J itself.
scope: Finite stars, positive vertex masses, conductances and variation weights, exponent p>1; one-input edge variation of nonlinear p-heat.
title: Universal mass threshold for weighted variation under nonlinear heat on stars
